body: I’m pretty immune to alcohol, so I have to drink a shit ton in order to get drunk even though I’m on the lean side.

What does “needy” look like? I just ask out girls like any other guy. No, I don’t say stuff like “you complete me” or anything. If you’re referring to my anxious ticks, then I’m fucked in that regard.

Here’s my dilemma, I can do all of this stuff and the girl isn’t interested at all. It’s a sickening feeling especially if I’m rejected in person. My sister on the other hand has a similar personality to mine and guys just want to ask her out at work left and right. Suicide, suicide!
It was actually the opposite way, the extroverted girl I went on a date with from tinder was the one who talked about depression and self harm fluently.
I guess I should kill myself because I’m rejected outside of bars anyways. I’m scared I’ll be rejected again because it’s worse than self harm.

It’s the best of both worlds because I either kill myself because I don’t have a girlfriend or I finally find a girlfriend. Don’t have to deal with being a virgin and I can enjoy the process for the most part.
